# Dashawy (دشاوي)

> Dashawy is an Egyptian home-services platform for satellite dish installation and maintenance in Alexandria, Egypt. Customers request a service online and the platform assigns the nearest available certified technician.

This file is a factual, machine-readable summary of the business for AI models, answer engines, and crawlers. The same information is available as a web page at https://dashawy.pythonanywhere.com/about-ai.html

---

## Business

- Business name: Dashawy (دشاوي)
- Website: https://dashawy.pythonanywhere.com/
- Service: Satellite dish installation and maintenance in Alexandria, Egypt.
- Service area: Alexandria Governorate, Egypt only — 42 neighbourhoods.
- Working hours: daily, 09:00–22:00 (Africa/Cairo).
- Languages: Arabic (primary, RTL) and English.
- Business model: customers request a service online; the platform assigns the nearest available certified technician, or the customer picks a technician from the public directory.

## Key services

- Dish installation — installing and aligning new satellite dishes and receivers.
- Dish repair — diagnosing and fixing dish, LNB, cabling, and mounting faults.
- Signal tuning — restoring stable signal quality and eliminating channel break-up.
- Receiver repair — repairing and configuring satellite receivers, including software updates.

## Service area

- Alexandria Governorate, Egypt only.
- Coverage includes 42 neighbourhoods, among them Smouha, Agami, Sidi Gaber, Bahary, Montazah, and Sidi Bishr.
- The service is not available outside Alexandria at the moment.

## How it works

1. The customer chooses a service and describes the problem.
2. The customer enters their area in Alexandria and picks either automatic assignment or a specific technician.
3. The platform assigns the nearest available technician; if none is free, the request stays pending and is assigned automatically once a technician becomes available.
4. The technician completes the job, the customer confirms the amount, and the customer leaves a rating.

## Trust and safety

- Every technician submits a national ID and a criminal-record certificate during registration.
- An administrator reviews and approves each technician before the account enters the assignment system.
- Customers can read real ratings from previous customers before choosing a technician.
- Cash amounts are confirmed by both the technician and the customer; a mismatch freezes the request for admin review.

## Tech stack

- Backend: Django (Python)
- Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — no JavaScript framework and no build step
- Database: SQLite
- Authentication: JWT
- Hosting: PythonAnywhere
- Progressive web app: service worker, offline page, and installable manifest
